name: SaneBox
tagline: AI email filtering that prioritizes your inbox automatically
painPoints: Only filters and organizes email, cannot draft, reply, or take action
Expensive for what is essentially a smart email filter ($7–$36/month)
No calendar, task, or workflow integration
Works on top of your email client rather than replacing it
AI filtering requires training over days or weeks to be accurate
metaDescription: Looking for a SaneBox alternative? GAIA is open-source AI that triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across 50+ tools. Free tier included.
whyPeopleLook: SaneBox is effective at separating important email from noise, but its intelligence stops at filtering. It moves email to folders but does not tell you what to do with those emails, cannot draft replies, and has no awareness of your tasks or calendar. Users who want a more active AI email partner, one that summarizes threads, drafts replies, creates tasks, and connects email to the rest of their workflow, quickly outgrow SaneBox.
gaiaReplaces: Intelligent inbox triage beyond folder sorting
Email summarization for long threads and digests
Task creation from emails that require follow-up action
Follow-up nudges when you haven't replied to important threads
Calendar event creation from scheduling emails
gaiaAdvantages: Takes action on email rather than just organizing it
Full calendar and task integration beyond email filtering
Proactive: surfaces urgent emails before you ask
Open-source with self-hosting for complete data privacy
Free tier includes meaningful email AI capabilities
migrationSteps: Cancel SaneBox and reconnect your inbox to GAIA via Gmail OAuth
Configure GAIA's inbox monitoring and priority preferences
Enable auto-task creation from emails requiring action
Use GAIA's daily email briefing to replace SaneBox digest summaries

faqs.question: Does GAIA filter and organize email like SaneBox?
faqs.answer: GAIA triages email proactively and can categorize and prioritize messages. Rather than moving email to folders automatically, GAIA surfaces what needs your attention and can take action, drafting replies, creating tasks, and scheduling meetings.

faqs.question: Is GAIA more expensive than SaneBox?
faqs.answer: SaneBox starts at $7/month for basic filtering. GAIA Pro is ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month but includes active email management, calendar, tasks, memory, and 50+ integrations. Self-hosted GAIA is free.

faqs.question: Can GAIA train on my email patterns like SaneBox?
faqs.answer: GAIA's memory system learns from your preferences and communication patterns over time, adjusting its triage and drafting to match how you work. This is more sophisticated than SaneBox's folder-based training.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work with email clients other than Gmail?
faqs.answer: GAIA's native integration is with Gmail. Other email providers can be connected via MCP integrations. SaneBox supports a wider range of email providers natively.

comparisonRows.gaia: Proactive AI assistant that monitors your inbox, understands content, and executes actions across email, tasks, calendar, and 50+ connected tools automatically
comparisonRows.competitor: Passive email filtering service: moves non-urgent messages into smart folders using machine-learning classification; never reads email body content

comparisonRows.gaia: Triages incoming email by urgency, auto-labels threads by category, and surfaces high-priority messages: adapts continuously using graph-based memory of your behavior and relationships
comparisonRows.competitor: Sorts email into SaneLater, SaneNews, SaneNoReplies, and custom folders; learns sender importance from your engagement; works with Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, and any IMAP client

comparisonRows.gaia: Generates context-aware reply drafts informed by prior conversation history, your calendar availability, linked tasks, and memory of the sender relationship
comparisonRows.competitor: No email drafting capability: SaneBox is a routing and filtering layer only; composing replies is left entirely to the user or their email client

comparisonRows.gaia: Automatically extracts action items from email bodies, creates structured tasks with priorities, deadlines, and project links, and syncs them to your task list without manual input
comparisonRows.competitor: No task creation: SaneBox does not read or parse email content; users must manually forward or copy information to a separate task manager

comparisonRows.gaia: Creates and updates Google Calendar events, finds free slots, schedules meetings from email requests, and generates pre-meeting briefing documents automatically
comparisonRows.competitor: No calendar integration: SaneBox operates exclusively within email and has no awareness of your schedule or meeting context

comparisonRows.gaia: Natural-language automations that span email, calendar, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Linear, and 50+ tools: for example, auto-create a Linear ticket from a bug-report email and post a Slack summary
comparisonRows.competitor: No workflow automation: SaneBox does not connect to tools outside email and has no automation engine

comparisonRows.gaia: Fully open source: self-host with Docker, retain full data ownership, and ensure your emails are never used for model training
comparisonRows.competitor: Closed-source proprietary SaaS; email metadata is processed on SaneBox servers; no self-hosting option available

comparisonRows.gaia: Free tier available; Pro from ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month; self-hosting is completely free with no usage caps
comparisonRows.competitor: Snack at $7/month (1 account, 2 features); Lunch at $12/month (2 accounts, 6 features); Dinner at $36/month (4 accounts, all features); 14-day free trial, no permanent free tier
